study.title: PP2A inhibition causes synthetic lethality in BRCA2-mutated prostate cancer models via spindle assembly checkpoint reactivation
study.identity_basis: Exact DOI/title on retrieved publisher main/PDF; PMID and PMCID linked in retained exact-source pointer and historical PMID question. No separate new identifier lookup claimed.

historical_question.original_question: Resolve the actual PP2A compounds and model-specific arms; keep worm genetic rescue separate from cancer-cell killing and inspect normal-cell specificity.
resolved_components: drug versus genetic and model-specific arms
normal/control relative sensitivity and its limits
unresolved_components: Some assay-specific exposure durations, cell denominators and independent-repeat mapping
Mouse enrollment-to-randomization accounting and omission/sensitivity rules
Formal pharmacological synergy and comprehensive normal-tissue specificity

central_judgment: Genetic checkpoint attenuation supplies the worm/cell survival rescue. LB100 supplies a distinct checkpoint-reactivation/tumor-killing strategy. No MVA restoration or human therapeutic recommendation follows.

assay_context.cold_stable_attachment: Monastrol 100 uM for 4 h, wash, MG132 10 uM for 1-2 h, then 15 min on ice before fixation (supplement p21). Arrest-assay endpoints cannot establish accurate completed division.
assay_context.live_imaging: Genetic HeLa mRFP-tubulin/GFP-H2B arm: double-thymidine synchronization, 4 h release before imaging every 5 min for 12 h (supplement p21-22). Selected videos not viewed.
assay_context.clonogenic: Specified drug exposures followed by equal treated-cell plating and colony counting after 10-14 days. Normalized to respective untreated control; absolute output from original starting population not supplied.
assay_context.statistics: Main Methods defines n as independent repeats unless otherwise indicated. Mean +/- SEM, two-sided t, chi-square, log-rank, one-/two-way ANOVA as captioned. Exact P/CI/post-hoc/multiplicity details often absent; no new inferential analysis performed.

interventions.name: Ceubxn-2 loss
interventions.contrast: ubxn-2 RNAi vs control/mak-2; double mutant vs brc-2
interventions.result: Hatching/brood rescue in brc-2 background, reduced N2 hatching with ubxn-2 RNAi; IR/HU sensitivity not rescued
interventions.test: One-way ANOVA Fig1C; unpaired two-sided t Fig1D, native **** P<0.0001

interventions.name: NSFL1C loss
interventions.result: BRCA2-deficient viability/mitotic survival and attachments improve, checkpoint association attenuates; HR/fork/DNA-damage defects persist; tumor growth increases with NSFL1C loss
interventions.n: Clonogenic/competitive-growth/selected attachment assays n3; genetic xenograft 13 shControl versus12 shNSFL1C; Fig2C/D explicit count/replicates not established
interventions.reported_values: Fig2C 100%,7.14%,75%,58.33% surviving mitoses for control,BRCA2,NSFL1C,double siRNA. Fig2D bipolar/multipolar cytokinesis/death remain distinct.
interventions.test: Fig2C chi-square, native ** P<0.01 for BRCA2 versus double; no denominator reverse-engineered

interventions.name: USP9X/air-2/bub-1/cul-4 perturbations
interventions.result: USP9X loss restores attachment metrics in BRCA2-siRNA HeLa; worm air-2/bub-1/cul-4 depletion partly restores hatching; not actual inhibitor administration
interventions.normal_counterevidence: Normal N2 brood drops with multiple gene depletions (Fig5J); UBXN2B loss does not reproduce NSFL1C rescue (S1J).

interventions.name: barasertib
interventions.n: 3 reported repeats in each caption; cells per repeat not specified
interventions.result: Fewer no/few cold-stable K-fibers under arrest
interventions.test: Unpaired two-sided t, native Fig4C *** P<0.001 and Fig6E **** P<0.0001
limits: Same six workbook percentages across two differently labelled models; see source inconsistencies
No additional drug-treated worm or actual-BUB1B model credit

interventions.name: NMS-873
interventions.n: Localization n3 caption; point-to-repeat mapping unclear; representative fractionation blots
interventions.result: Restores AURKB centromeric/chromatin association after NSFL1C/USP9X loss
interventions.test: Two-way ANOVA for localization; native **** labels, not a demonstrated BUBR1 abundance or division result

interventions.name: LB100
interventions.exposure: 10 uM in LNCaP imaging; exact imaging duration unresolved
models: LNCaP control, BRCA2, NSFL1C and double siRNA
interventions.n: 3 caption; raw intensity rows not mapped to biological repeats
interventions.result: Raises AURKB-T232ph and increases no/few K-fibers in double depletion; authors interpret SAC reactivation
interventions.test: Two-way ANOVA; native **** significant selected contrasts, NS indicated for matched destabilized states

interventions.name: LB100
interventions.n: 3 reported independent repeats; plotted values normalized to corresponding untreated control
interventions.result: Greater loss in selected BRCA2/SAC-silenced contexts, with nonzero killing also in control/proficient comparators
interventions.test: Two-way ANOVA; native comparison stars retained in figures; no IC50 or formal therapeutic window calculated

interventions.name: olaparib
interventions.exposure: 24 h, 1 and2.5uM in VC-8 and MCF10A
interventions.result: BRCA2 deficiency affects sensitivity; NSFL1C co-loss partly attenuates olaparib sensitivity in MCF10A
limits: No human drug response in this paper

interventions.name: LB100 plus olaparib
interventions.exposure: PC3M-2B4 LB1001uM plus olaparib0/0.5/1/2.5uM,24h; LNCaP uses LB1005uM plus olaparib series in S7H
interventions.result: Combination reduces clonogenic survival relative to olaparib alone; authors call synergy
interventions.test: Two-way ANOVA, native Figure7E **** P<0.0001. Formal synergy interaction/additivity model not supplied.
limits: S7H source sheet does not reconcile its displayed genotype series
Do not claim a quantified synergistic index

interventions.name: LB100 xenograft monotherapy
interventions.model: VC-8 versus VC-8+BRCA2 subcutaneous tumors in five-week-old female BALB/c nude mice
interventions.result: Greater tumor suppression in BRCA2-deficient VC-8; body-weight contrasts displayed nonsignificant
interventions.test: Two-way ANOVA; native selected tumor contrast ****
limits: Native time axis days after treatment vs workbook label after implantation conflict
No survival-extension endpoint or comprehensive toxicity analysis

interventions.name: LB100/olaparib four-arm xenograft
interventions.exposure: LB1002mg/kg and olaparib75mg/kg intraperitoneally according to Figure7G graphical schedule, randomization day10; BLI days10/18/25/31
interventions.model: PC3M-2B4-Luc subcutaneous tumors in nude mice
interventions.n: 35 implanted stated; allocated DMSO7/olaparib8/LB1007/combination8 total30; workbook seven numeric animals/arm at each time
interventions.result: Combination lowers BLI more than monotherapies; no significant weight contrasts reported
interventions.test: Two-way ANOVA; exact selected pairwise native symbols retained; no prespecified hierarchy, multiplicity rule or formal synergy test established
interventions.deaths: Combination day28 and olaparib day30; causes not adjudicated in examined text
limits: Five implanted animals unaccounted for in allocation
Missing trajectories for two later-death animals from all displayed timepoints; no sensitivity analysis

interventions.name: Assay/challenge compounds
interventions.kind: actual procedural or damage challenge reagents
names: hydroxyurea4/8mM24h or4mM5h fiber assay;25mM worm challenge
interventions.result: Synchronization, mechanistic perturbation, mutagenesis or unrepaired damage sensitivity; no automatic new medicine appraisal. RO3306 changes AURKB polyubiquitination/complex association in Figure5G/H and S5E/F, not a therapeutic rescue.

observational_human_context.expression_association: Figure6A low/high BRCA2 mRNA strata n56 each; expression strata are not the separately mutation-verified IHC cohort.
observational_human_context.disease_free_survival: Figure6B all-expression AURKB-low/high n56/56, log-rank P0.0093; low-BRCA2 subset low/high AURKB n40/4, P0.4013 (nonsignificant).
observational_human_context.IHC: 22 BRCA2-WT sporadic versus10 hereditary germline-BRCA2-mutant prostate carcinoma samples, NGS-confirmed; lower NSFL1C/AURKB staining, unpaired two-sided t.

source_inconsistencies.finding: Exactly identical six percentages labelled HeLa and LNCaP; native reported significance levels differ under the same named test.
source_inconsistencies.handling: Preserve reported positive but do not regard as independently reconciled numerical replication; do not infer misconduct or replace source values.

source_inconsistencies.finding: Identical single-contrast numbers despite LNCaP/5uM and PC3M/1uM labels; native S7H has eight genotype/drug series not represented by sheet.
source_inconsistencies.handling: No reconstruction of missing genotype series or exact S7H quantitative claim.

source_inconsistencies.finding: 35 implanted versus30 assigned. Later-death animal columns contain death at day10 then blanks, with no numerical earlier trajectory.
source_inconsistencies.handling: No baseline-death inference, zero imputation or cause attribution. Seven numerical animals per arm is observed in these sheets; endpoint exclusions/analysis rules unresolved.

source_inconsistencies.finding: Native days after treatment versus workbook days after cell implantation; Methods drug start two weeks after inoculation.
source_inconsistencies.handling: Keep source labels and do not silently align calendars.

source_inconsistencies.finding: Workbook sheet titles swap the brood/hatching panel association relative to native Figure5J/K; some cullin labels say cul-2 where native/main say cul-3.
source_inconsistencies.handling: Use native figures/text to identify genetic experiments; no automated value import across these labels.

BUBR1_and_MVA_boundary.S4AB: NSFL1C co-loss does not restore centromeric p-BubR1(T680) or PP2A-B56 in BRCA2-siRNA HeLa; representative images, no quantified rescue.
BUBR1_and_MVA_boundary.global_vs_local: LB100 pharmacological PP2A inhibition in this source is different from genetic/local PP2A recruitment described in retained MVA patient-fibroblast qualification.

source_reading_depth.limits: Displayed native figures were inspected, not blinded remeasured. Raw image integrity, laboratory reproducibility, individual subject truth, genotype sequencing and all statistical calculations were not independently validated.

independent_review_depth.main: Complete scientific main in retained PDF-layout text: abstract, Introduction, Results, Discussion, Methods, captions, funding/COI and author/data statements. Bibliography entries are pointers, not independently read cited papers.
independent_review_depth.supplement: All seven figure captions and expanded scientific Methods read in retained layout extraction; all seven native figure pages viewed. Tables 1–2 inspected as reagent/genotype context, without sequence/genotype validation. Separate table3 and video files were not opened.
independent_review_depth.selected_data: Read descriptive-source-values.json and selected entries from both supporting-data JSON extracts. Compared six Fig 4C/Fig 6E cells and 24 Fig 7E/S7H cells for exact identity; counted numerical entries and inspected death/blanks for Fig 7G/S7I; checked Fig 7C axis header. No mean/CI/statistical-test reanalysis.

independent_review_depth.narrow_unconfirmed_item: The author-noted Figure 5J/K workbook-label swap is not independently rechecked against workbook sheets in this review; native genetic panels and their scope were inspected.
